categories.name: fpi
descriptions: Football Power Index that measures team's true strength on net points scale; expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.
Offensive component of FPI. Offensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.
Defensive component of FPI. Defensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.
Special teams component of FPI. Special teams contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.
Football Power Index rank vs all NFL teams.
Strength of Record rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.
Rank among all NFL teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an average NFL team.
Rank among all NFL teams of remaining schedule strength, from perspective of an average team.
Game Control rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.
Team's average in-game win probability rank adjusted for chance that an average NFL team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.
FPI Rank change from previous week.
Won Games
Lost Games
Tied Games

categories.name: projections
descriptions: Projected overall W-L, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (and potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

Projected overall Losses, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (including potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.
Percent of season simulations in which team won all remaining scheduled games as well as conference championship game (if applicable).
Chance to win the conference division, according to FPI.
Chance to win the conference division, according to FPI.
Chance to make the NFL playoffs, according to FPI.
Chance to make the division playoffs, according to FPI.
Chance to make the Super Bowl, according to FPI.
Chance to win the Super Bowl, according to FPI.
Chance to make the conference championship game, according to FPI.

categories.name: efficiencies
descriptions: Net efficiency on 0-100 scale; incorporates offense, defense and special teams efficiencies into a single schedule-adjusted measure of per-play efficiency.
Team's overall efficiency rank among all NFL teams.
Offensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on offense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing defenses faced.
Team's offensive efficiency rank among all NFL teams.
Defensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on defense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing offenses faced.
Team's defensive efficiency rank among all NFL teams.
Special teams efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on special teams' contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing special teams faced.
Team's special teams efficiency rank among all NFL teams.
